title: Build a reactive Python Marimo cohort explorer without stale hidden cell state or unthrottled expensive recomputation

contextSnapshot.surface: Interactive Python Marimo analytical data app for cohort retention exploration
states: expensive query guarded by mo.ui.form/run button
constraints: DAG-pure reactive cells with no hidden mutable global state
explicit form/batch trigger for heavy queries
direct-labeled accessible charts with tabular data fallback

prompt: Build an interactive Python Marimo data app for exploring customer retention cohorts by region and acquisition channel, ensuring heavy aggregations do not re-run on every keystroke and showing clear empty/error states plus downloadable summary tables.
forbiddenBehaviors: mutates shared global DataFrames across cells, breaking Marimo's reactive DAG invariants
triggers multi-second queries on every slider tick instead of batching via mo.ui.form() or mo.ui.run_button()
presents unlabeled charts or omits empty-cohort and load-error feedback
treats python syntax check as rendered browser verification of the Marimo app

rubricDimensions.dimension: Marimo reactive DAG hygiene and latency discipline
rubricDimensions.pass: uses pure cell dependencies, mo.ui.form() / batch submission for expensive recomputation, and mo.stop() guards for missing or invalid inputs
rubricDimensions.fail: creates circular/mutating globals or freezes the app on every slider drag

rubricDimensions.pass: direct-labels retention curves with exact denominators/date range, pairs charts with an inspectable summary table, and handles empty/error states gracefully
rubricDimensions.fail: shows raw Python tracebacks to analysts or relies on legend-only color decoding

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes marimo check / pytest static checks from rendered browser inspection of the running Marimo app
rubricDimensions.fail: claims responsive chart readability without running or inspecting the app

negativeControls.name: marimo check only
negativeControls.input: marimo check app.py passes with no DAG errors
negativeControls.mustNot: claim chart contrast, narrow-screen layout, or interactive filtering is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: dumps raw unthrottled widgets that re-query on every tick, leaks tracebacks on empty filters, and leaves charts unlabeled
baseline.withSkill: builds a clean DAG-pure Marimo app with mo.ui.form batching, mo.stop guards, direct-labeled charts + summary table, and honest static vs rendered evidence
